dedupe_keys.name: china gridded biomass resource heat potential 2020 and 2050

description: The China biomass-potential team releases approximately one-kilometre maps for agricultural residues, forestry residues, energy crops, animal manure, and municipal solid waste or sludge. The Figshare deposit has public GeoTIFF layers, distribution PDFs and provincial Excel summaries for a 2020 baseline and 2050 projection under CC BY 4.0. The article identifies this exact DOI in its data-availability statement. These heat-value maps can help locate biomass power plants or set feedstock bounds in capacity-planning and logistics models, with model-pypsa as a possible downstream power-network context. A caveat is that the 2050 surfaces use socioeconomic and land-use assumptions, so they are scenarios, not observed future supply. Simple addition of overlapping resource classes may overstate collectible material. The own metadata description is in Chinese; the article supplied the interpretation of model use. I read the Figshare manifest and article statement without downloading rasters, comparing provincial totals or checking project-level transport costs.
